title: Retrieval Profile
description: Named, versioned retrieval weight bundle, replacing a single hard-coded 0.4 BM25 + 0.4 vector + 0.2 spatial split. New schema — not present in handoff-audit/phase1-design/schemas/; added per docs/spatialrag_migration/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §4 (see schemas/contracts/README.md).

weights.description: Eight named signals. Logged explicitly per query — never fixed or hidden. Freshness must never automatically outrank authoritative older evidence; it is one signal among eight, not a tiebreaker applied after the fact.

hyde_enabled.description: Disabled by default for forensic/FOIA-style work. An opt-in experimental run setting this true MUST log a non-HyDE baseline comparison alongside (see analytical_run_receipt.v1's hyde_enabled const false requirement for the default profile set).

x-invariants: weights should sum to 1 (retrieval_profile.weights_sum_to_1) — enforced by a Phase 2 contract test, not expressible as a JSON Schema cross-field constraint.
hyde_enabled=true requires a logged non-HyDE baseline comparison and must not affect evidence tier or confidence.
The query planner may recommend a profile; the selected profile_id is always logged against the resulting Claim/AnalyticalClaim (see analytical_run_receipt.v1).
